rating.source: 800 hp [AS: the owner's request, 2026-10-06] x 0.745699872 kW/hp [D] = 596.56 kW; the target the jets were sized for, not a cited rating. Measured on the hyper V8 (dyno-held, after N3): +539/+545/+620/+683/+622 kW at 3000/4000/5000/6000/7000 rpm, mean +602 kW (tests/validation/test_car_hyper_n2o.cpp).

source: A custom wet plate (fogger-style, one nitrous jet and one fuel jet) sized for an 800 hp shot on engines/hyper_v8_one1_audio.json (N2O plan N7; every number [AS] unless stated). The N2O jet: mass flow = Cd * A * G_HEM(p_bottle) with G_HEM(950 psig) = 32782 kg/(m2 s) [D: the oxidizer table's HEM critical flux, out/n2o_plan.md section 2.2]. The shot's crank work per kg of N2O is about 2.46 MJ/kg [D: out/n2o_plan.md section 9, confirmed by the dyno-held measurement: +600 kW at 0.245 kg/s before N3]. 597 kW / 2.46 MJ/kg = 0.243 kg/s, so A = 0.243 / (0.66 * 32782) = 1.123e-5 m2, d = 3.78 mm. After the N3 turbo exhaust balance the shot also raises boost at 5000-7000 rpm (the turbo reaches the model's 180000 rpm cap and the charge pressure 2.0-2.4 bar against the 1.8 bar target), which adds to the gain, so a dyno-held sweep of 3.4/3.6/3.8 mm picked 3.6 mm (0.220 kg/s): mean gain over 3000-7000 rpm +602 kW = 807 hp. nitrous_jet_cd 0.66 [C: Dyer et al. 2007 mean discharge coefficient as reported by Waxman et al., the same value as the shipped Edelbrock kits; measured range 0.6-0.8]. flow_model hem [AS: out/n2o_plan.md owner Q1 recommended default]. injection plenum: one plate ahead of the throttle plenum (physically identical to direct_port at the mean-value level, out/n2o_plan.md 2.4). The fuel jet: sized for a combined lambda of about 0.85 [AS: the usual rich N2O target, 0.80-0.90]; 1.45 mm at Cd 0.70 [AS: a sharp-edged short orifice, inside the Lichtarowicz, Duggins and Markland 1965 range] and 4.0 bar over the MANIFOLD [AS: a regulated pump-fed fuel rail, e.g. 3-5 bar; reference manifold because the engine runs 2.8 bar absolute at WOT, where an atmosphere-referenced carburettor-style supply like the Edelbrock sheets' 6.5 psi would not flow at all] gives 28.3 g/s of E5 (rho 747.5 kg/m3 [C: EN 228 midpoint]); measured combined lambda 0.83-0.84 (the engine's own ECU already runs lambda 0.82 at boost). UNVALIDATED: no cited kit exists at this size; PROVISIONAL.
